title: Lever Digital Alternatives for Paid Social and Meta Video
summary: Lever Digital alternatives for Meta video ads and paid social, compared by channel mix and published pricing, with Knowlify as our top pick for Meta video.
body_markdown:
The best Lever Digital alternative for Meta video ads is Knowlify, which makes about 25 finished AI video ads a week and can run your Meta campaigns or deliver creative only. Lever Digital is a UK PPC agency built on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, with LinkedIn and Meta added when the audience justifies them, so if you need a search-led replacement, compare Darkroom, MuteSix and NoGood on channel scope first.


Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What Lever Digital covers, and what it leaves out


Lever Digital says it plans and runs paid search and paid social, and it measures success by CRM-linked pipeline, revenue and cost per acquisition rather than clicks or form fills. Its services include Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn and Meta, along with AI search visibility, SEO, conversion rate optimization, lead generation and affiliate marketing.[Lever Digital](https://www.leverdigital.co.uk/)


Its homepage does not mention creative or video production. It names B2B companies, SaaS, fintech and financial services, and eCommerce as its sectors, and it does not state a minimum media spend or company size. The published fee is a flat £1,500 a month for media under £15k, 10% of spend above that, plus £500 a month if LinkedIn is included. Contracts are rolling monthly with no markup on media. Ask Lever how the 10% is calculated at your spend, and treat any results on an agency's own site as self-reported until you see the account reports behind them.


## Knowlify: our top pick for Meta video ads made every week


Knowlify is the best fit when the gap in your account is Meta creative rather than search, because it makes about 25 finished ads a week for Facebook and Instagram and the first batch lands on day 5. It offers three formats: AI UGC with AI presenters talking to camera, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. A person checks every ad before delivery, and pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card.


You can take creative only, if another team already runs the account, or add end-to-end[Meta ads management](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) . Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund; the terms are on the site, at[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) . To scope a first batch,[book a call](https://knowlify.com/book) .


When to pick another option: Knowlify does not run Google, TikTok, LinkedIn or YouTube ads, so in a split setup keep search with a search specialist and treat Knowlify as the Meta video supplier.


## Which alternatives cover search, paid social or both?


The table compares alternatives on the channels they publish. Knowlify comes first. The others cover Meta alongside other channels, with different creative, pricing and minimum terms.


Provider Channels (as published, October 2026) Pricing signal Pick it when


Knowlify Meta video ads: finished AI video, with optional campaign management or creative only Custom quote You need Meta video creative and keep search elsewhere


[Darkroom](https://darkroomagency.com/) Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Pinterest, retail media and CTV From $1,500 a month plus a percentage of media You run several channels and fit its revenue range


[MuteSix](https://mutesix.com/) Paid social, paid search on Google, retail media, programmatic and SMS Not published You want paid social and search in one plan


[Creative Milkshake](https://www.creativemilkshake.com/) Paid media across Meta, TikTok and YouTube, with studio and creator production Not published You want multi-language creative from European hubs


[NoGood](https://nogood.io/paid-social-agency/) Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, Snapchat, X and YouTube Average retainer above $20,000 a month You want a growth team across paid social platforms


Darkroom and MuteSix both put Google search next to Meta. Darkroom says its fit is poor for single-channel brands and companies under roughly $5M in revenue. MuteSix does not publish pricing or minimums, so ask for the scope and the fee basis in writing. Creative Milkshake lists London among its six European hubs, but its published channels are Meta, TikTok and YouTube, with no Google search named.[Creative Milkshake locations](https://www.creativemilkshake.com/locations)


If you chose Lever Digital for its B2B and SaaS focus,[NoGood](https://nogood.io/paid-social-agency/) lists SaaS, B2B, fintech and healthcare among its industries and covers Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other paid social platforms, which overlaps Lever's LinkedIn and Meta mix. Its average retainer is above $20,000 a month, so it is a larger commitment than Lever's published fee.
